newsitem.title: USA: REPUBLIC MOVES AGAINST TOYOTA IN TENNESSEE.
newsitem.headline: REPUBLIC MOVES AGAINST TOYOTA IN TENNESSEE.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Thursday that it has been unable to work out a compromise with Toyota Motor Sales USA Inc regarding its ownership of Toyota dealerships and will seek to resolve the matter through a Tenneessee state agency.

Republic said that it has filed a petition with the Tennessee Motor Vehicle Commission seeking a declaratory judgment, injunctive relief, and civil and criminal penalties and sanctions against Toyota in relation to its proposed ownership of Toyota dealerships in Tennessee.

Republic said Toyota's policies restrict a dealer's right to sell and Republic's ability to buy dealerships in Tennessee, limiting it to acquiring seven Toyota dealerships nationally over a five-year period and requiring it to waive forever its legal rights to own additional dealerships.
Toyota USA representatives were not immediately available for comment.

Republic Industries owns the nation's largest chain of new vehicle dealerships and is building a chain of used car megastores, which it operates under the AutoNation USA brand name. It also has interests in waste services, rental cars, and automobile finance.
